notes.title: Freddy Spaghetti 2.0!
notes.content:
[h1]Freddy Spaghetti 2.0![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37063300/468e7cb87c591502b3d548a94f8d41a407eb891c.png[/img]

Hi there everyone!

Guess what!?
...

Well I guess the title sorta spoiled it...
That's right, Freddy Spaghetti 2.0 is out!
You can get it on Steam here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1452220/Freddy_Spaghetti_20/]Freddy 2.0 on Steam[/url]

It's a tad bit shorter than the first one, but it's also cheaper!!!
AAAAAAND, chock full of memes!  No joke, well, I mean a lot of those but...

You know what, just check it out for yourselves.

If munies is tight, you can check out this awesome YouTuber playing it here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n8ejVHAGQMI]Freddy 2.0 Gameplay[/url]
PART 2:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wEBxkIJJr2E]Part 2[/url]

Maybe give him a sub, like and whatever else the kids always talk about on the tube!


More surprises to come, watch this space!

Anyway, thanks everybody,
David
